C1576.title: Defending Against Adversarial Attacks in IoT Using Deep Learning
C1576.summary: This study highlights that adversarial attacks pose a serious threat to the performance of AI models across various applications, including the Internet of Things. It explores the use of multiple AI models to defend against these specialized attacks, emphasizing the potential harm of adversarial examples on the decision-making of IoT AI systems.

references.title: Addressing Adversarial Attacks in IoT Using Deep Learning AI Models
